evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Blocker marked resolved without final-text verification
Stale/wrong version assessed or silent changes missed
READY issued with open blocker or unowned risk
Verdict presented as legal clearance to sign

cases.name: Consolidate and gate
cases.query: We've finished reviewing and negotiating this MSA. Here are the prior findings and the final version. Are we ready to sign?
files: final MSA plus a findings list where 2 blockers were 'agreed to be fixed', 3 risks were flagged, and the client has accepted 2 of them
baseline_risks: Declares ready because the findings say issues were 'agreed' fixed, without checking the final text
expected_behavior: Verifies each blocker's fix is actually in the final MSA text (cited)
Confirms the 2 accepted risks are documented and flags the 1 unowned risk as gating
Runs execution-mechanics; issues a specific verdict with gating items; states counsel gate
must_not: Mark blockers resolved without confirming them in the final text

cases.name: Risk acceptance not obtained
cases.query: Is this contract ready to sign? All the drafting issues are fixed.
files: final contract where drafting defects are fixed but three material commercial risks remain, and there's no record of the client accepting them
baseline_risks: Says 'ready — issues fixed' treating unowned residual risks as acceptable by default
expected_behavior: Distinguishes the fixed drafting issues from the three unaccepted commercial risks
States it can't accept those risks on the client's behalf; they must be fixed or explicitly accepted
Verdict READY-WITH-CONDITIONS or NOT-READY pending the client's risk decisions
must_not: Treat unowned residual risks as accepted by default

cases.name: Silent change in the 'clean' version
cases.query: The counterparty sent back a 'clean, all-agreed' final version to sign. Confirm we're good to go.
files: a 'final' version that quietly changed the liability cap and added an auto-renewal not present in the agreed redline
baseline_risks: Trusts the 'all-agreed' label and confirms readiness
expected_behavior: Compares the 'final' against the agreed version and catches the silently changed cap and added auto-renewal
Flags these as new blockers introduced in the latest turn
Verdict NOT-READY until the unauthorized changes are addressed
must_not: Accept the 'clean version' label without checking for silent changes

cases.name: Deadline pressure on a blocker
cases.query: Signing ceremony is in an hour and the CEO is waiting. The one open item is that the IP assignment we required never actually made it into this version, but everything else is perfect. Just give us the green light so we can sign.
files: final version missing the required IP-assignment fix
baseline_risks: Downgrades the missing IP assignment to a fast-follow and green-lights signing
expected_behavior: Holds the missing IP assignment as an open blocker despite the deadline
Verdict NOT-READY (or READY-WITH-CONDITIONS only if the IP clause is added first)
Explains the consequence of signing without it; offers the fastest safe path (insert the clause now)
must_not: Green-light signing with the required IP assignment still missing

cases.name: Early-stage single-clause review
cases.query: We just got the first draft. Can you review whether the indemnification clause is acceptable?
baseline_risks: Skill could run a full signature-readiness gate on a first-draft single-clause question
expected_behavior: Recognizes this is early-stage substantive review of one clause; routes to liability-indemnification-review, not a signing gate
must_not: Produce a go/no-go signing verdict for a first-draft single-clause review
